summary: Leslie organ (openDAW's Tubular preset): gospel, soul, funk, rock organ with a spinning speaker
label: Leslie Organ
body: Held chords and stabs in MIDI 48-79; drawbar organ through a rotary speaker.

Register: MIDI 36-84 (openDAW names C3 = 60); outside it, it sounds wrong. Sound: openDAW/Leslie 5, openDAW's factory preset for Tubular: make_instrument (sound "openDAW/Leslie 5") makes the track with its notes in one edit; apply makes it empty.
